articles.title: Steelers' Metcalf shoves fan during game in Detroit

articles.title: Back injury forces Ravens' Jackson from SNF loss
articles.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson left Sunday night's game against the Patriots late in the first half because of a back injury. He said he hopes to play Saturday at Green Bay but will first have an MRI on Monday.

articles.title: Defiant Jags shift narrative, beat 1-seed Broncos

articles.title: Sources: Broncos' Bryant discharged from hospital
articles.summary: Pat Bryant was discharged from an area hospital Sunday night after being diagnosed with a concussion, but cleared of other major injuries, following a big hit in the final minute of the team's 34-20 loss to the Jaguars, sources told ESPN.
